newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Man takes joyride in Siberian train.
newsitem.headline: Man takes joyride in Siberian train.

text.p: Russian police are looking for a man who took a locomotive for a joyride on a major Siberian railway, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.

It said an unidentified person had introduced himself as a train driver to a duty officer on Wednesday at Tynda station on the Baikal-Amur line which runs from Lake Baikal to Russia's Far East. He then drove the locomotive away.
It was found abandoned late at night not far from the station but there are no clues to the identity of the driver.
